gizmo.title: Kauwhata Porowhita
gizmo.description: Ka waihanga i tētahi kauwhata wātea i runga i tētahi CSV.

configure.title: Kōnae CSV
configure.description: Uta raraunga mai i tētahi CSV.

configure.title: Taitara Kauwhata
configure.description: Kuputuhi alt wātea mō tō kauwhata.

configure.title: Ingoa Tauine
configure.description: Te ōwehenga whānui:teitei o te kauwhata (Tirohia https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings mō $ct-scales me $ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Tapeke
configure.description: Tapeke kōwhiringa ka taea e koe te tohu. Mā te tohu i tētahi uara tapeke, me ōrite te tapeke o ngā uara i te raupapa ki tēnei tapeke kia tuhia he porowhita katoa. Ka taea e koe te whakamahi i tēnei tawhā hei tuhi i ētahi wāhanga anake o tētahi kauwhata porowhita, ine rānei.

configure.title: Waiho ngā Uara Kau
configure.description: Ka waihotia ngā uara kau kia kore ai e tuhia ngā poro me ngā tapanga kāore e hiahiatia ana.

advanced.title: Kōaro Raraunga
advanced.description: Kōaro i ngā raraunga tae atu ki ngā tapanga, te raupapa raupapa me ngā huānga raraunga raupapa katoa.

advanced.title: Ripanga HTML
advanced.description: Kōwhiringa: Uta raraunga hei ripanga HTML.

advanced.title: Tōnati Totoka
advanced.description: Tuhia ngā wāhanga tōnati hei āhua, kaua hei whiu.

advanced.title: Ahunga Tapanga
advanced.description: Tuhia ngā wāhanga tōnati hei āhua, kaua hei whiu.

advanced.title: Neke Tapanga
advanced.description: Te neke o te tūranga tapanga mai i te tūranga paerewa, arā, te haurua o te tawhiti o te pūtoro. Ka taea tēnei uara te tōrunga, te tōraro rānei. Ka whakatakoto ngā uara tōrunga i te tapanga kia matara atu i te pokapū.
